title: Missions and Evangelism
description: The theology, history and practice of Christian mission and evangelism. Students study the mission of God through the whole Bible, the apostolic mission in Acts, the history of missions from the early church to the global South, the theology of salvation and the nations, contextualization and culture, church planting, personal and congregational evangelism, mercy and justice in mission, and partnership in world Christianity today.
